claims.quote: Only the hit count is recorded for each short link; nothing about the visitor is stored.
claims.statement: Each short link records only its hit count; no information about the visitor is stored.

claims.quote: Rate limiting is on by default, so a single client cannot flood the redirect endpoint.
claims.statement: Rate limiting of the redirect endpoint is enabled by default.

claims.quote: Short codes are six characters long.
claims.statement: Generated short codes are six characters long.

claims.quote: Links never expire unless you set an expiry when you create them.
claims.statement: By default a link does not expire; an expiry applies only when set at creation.

claims.quote: Passwords for the admin console are hashed with argon2.
claims.statement: Admin console passwords are hashed with argon2.

claims.quote: All configuration options are documented in docs/CONFIG.md.
claims.statement: The configuration options are documented in docs/CONFIG.md.

claims.quote: The default database is SQLite, so a single file is all the state there is.
claims.statement: The default database is SQLite and all state lives in one file.
